headline: Fort Hays State and Southern Nazarene open with two wins
dek: Fort Hays State beat Rogers State and Northeastern State at home two days apart, and Southern Nazarene did the same to Harding and Ouachita Baptist. Rogers State ended a run of two defeats by winning at Newman on Saturday. Northeastern State have lost both of their conference matches, each by a single goal.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman and Northeastern State put together.

wire.line: Fort Hays State have lost once all season and conceded five goals; they share the top of the table with Southern Nazarene.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas remains the one match past its date with no result published.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding have conceded 23 goals in losing all seven of their matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rogers State's seventeen goals have come from at least twelve different scorers.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southern Nazarene have won five times and lost twice, beating Oklahoma Christian, Harding and Ouachita Baptist since their defeat at Midwestern State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Len Valkema has scored four goals for Fort Hays State from fourteen shots.

last_match.line: Harding have lost every match they have played, and return to conference play when Fort Hays State visit.

next_match.line: Southern Nazarene have won every match since their defeat at Midwestern State; Northeastern State have yet to take a point in the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
